ceu: ✦ The square between the Sun and Jupiter

t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
Until {H:1809867550000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The square between the Sun and Jupiter creates some tension between money and romance. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
Until {H:1809867550000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The square between the Sun and Jupiter creates some tension between your image and family. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
Until {H:1809867550000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The square between the Sun and Jupiter creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
Until {H:1809867550000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The square between the Sun and Jupiter creates some tension between friendships and money. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
Until {H:1809867550000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The square between the Sun and Jupiter creates some tension between your career and your image. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
Until {H:1809867550000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The square between the Sun and Jupiter creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
Until {H:1809867550000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The square between the Sun and Jupiter creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
Until {H:1809867550000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
The square between the Sun and Jupiter creates some tension between relationships and your career. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
Until {H:1809867550000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The square between the Sun and Jupiter creates some tension between routine and your horizons. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
Until {H:1809867550000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
The square between the Sun and Jupiter creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
Until {H:1809867550000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The square between the Sun and Jupiter creates some tension between family and relationships. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
Until {H:1809867550000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up home and family.
The square between the Sun and Jupiter creates some tension between conversations and routine. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.
